'''Camp 14''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camp established by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. It was established next to a [[Unidentified Naboo town|trading town]] north of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="GB" />
